title: Spectrogram terrain
technique: A scrolling history of the last few seconds of the sound spectrum becomes a height map, drawn as a landscape of glowing ridge lines that recede from the viewer.
music: The frequency spectrum is the shape of the land itself, with the newest sound at the near edge, and each kick drum sends a bright swell rolling away, nudges the camera and flashes the standing words. The sung note sets the height of a ribbon of light, the bass note tints the horizon glow, and snare hits split the colours.

takes.name: Valley
takes.description: The original view: a tall extruded phrase stands in a line-drawn valley under a sun made from the spectrum, in green and amber on an old-monitor screen.
words:
SPECTRUM
TERRAIN

LOUDER IS
HIGHER

BASS BUILDS
WALLS

EVERY FRAME THE SOUND SPECTRUM BECOMES THE FRONT ROW OF A HEIGHT MAP.
OLDER ROWS SLIDE AWAY. BASS BUILDS THE WALLS, A KICK IS A WHITE RIDGE.

takes.name: Skim
takes.description: A low, wide-angle forward flight in ice blue with no standing phrase, where the rows of the landscape rush at the lens and a small text readout sits in the corner.
words:
256 BY 192 HEIGHT MAP OF THE SPECTRUM, ONE NEW ROW EVERY FRAME.
THE HORIZON IS NOW. THE ROWS FLYING PAST ARE THE LAST FEW SECONDS.

EACH LINE RUSHING AT THE LENS IS ONE FRAME OF SOUND, NEWEST AT THE
HORIZON. THE RIBBON OVERHEAD HANGS AT THE PITCH OF THE VOICE.

takes.name: Tunnel
takes.description: The landscape is rolled into a red tube with the camera inside, rolling with each bar while kicks travel down it as white rings toward a round sun at the far end.
words:
THE SAME HEIGHT MAP ROLLED INTO A TUBE: FREQUENCY RUNS ROUND THE WALL,
TIME RUNS DOWN THE BORE. KICKS ARE WHITE RINGS. THE BAR ROLLS THE CAMERA.

takes.name: Map
takes.description: A daylight view straight down onto cream paper, where the land becomes ink contour lines with a blue height tint, kicks are stamped as red hatched bands and a title block labels the sheet.
words:
CONTOUR MAP OF SOUND FROM STRAIGHT ABOVE: LINES JOIN EQUAL LOUDNESS,
BLUER IS LOUDER. RED HATCHED BANDS ARE KICK DRUMS CROSSING THE SHEET.

THE SPECTRUM HISTORY PRINTED AS A SURVEY SHEET: TIME ALONG ONE AXIS,
FREQUENCY ALONG THE OTHER. A SNARE KNOCKS THE INK OUT OF REGISTER.

takes.name: Dusk
takes.description: Solid, lit mountains in pink fog under a small sun, with a phrase standing small and far away instead of the usual line drawing.
words:
HEIGHT IS
LOUDNESS

ONE ROW
PER FRAME

SHADED
SOLID

THE SAME SPECTRUM HEIGHT MAP SHADED AS SOLID ROCK: ONE SUN, DISTANCE FOG.
THE THIN STRATA ARE ITS ROWS. A KICK DRUM IS A GLOWING BAND ROLLING AWAY.

takes.name: Chart
takes.description: No perspective at all: the rows are stacked flat like a seismograph trace in pure black and white dots with a caption, sometimes inverted or turned on its side.
words:
ONE TRACE PER FRAME OF SOUND, STACKED FLAT WITH NO PERSPECTIVE.
BASS IS IN THE MIDDLE. EACH TRACE HIDES THE ONES BEHIND IT.

THE SPECTRUM HISTORY AS A SEISMOGRAPH IN PURE BLACK AND WHITE:
ORDERED DITHER AT 640 BY 360. THE BEAT THICKENS THE DOTS.

takes.name: Planet
takes.description: The landscape is wrapped around an amber globe turning in a field of stars, seen either whole or close along its edge, with kicks swelling a band around it.
words:
THE HEIGHT MAP WRAPPED ON A SPHERE: FREQUENCY IS LONGITUDE, NEW SOUND
ENTERS AT THE NORTH POLE AND TRAVELS SOUTH. A KICK SWELLS ONE LATITUDE.

SPECTRUM PLANET: A 256 BY 192 GRID PUSHED OUT BY THE LAST SECONDS OF
SOUND. IT TURNS FASTER WHEN THE MUSIC IS LOUD.

takes.name: Pond
takes.description: A spiral disc of cream ripples on black spreads outward from a red phrase at its centre, each kick leaving the middle as a new ring.
words:
NOW IS
THE CENTRE

KICKS MAKE
RINGS

THE HEIGHT MAP AS A SPIRAL DISC: FREQUENCY IS THE ANGLE, NEW SOUND STARTS
AT THE CENTRE AND SPREADS OUT. EACH KICK DRUM LEAVES THE MIDDLE AS A RING.

as_processor: Lays the picture on the landscape as relief: bright areas rise and colour the ridge lines, contours or rock, while the sound spectrum still ripples through it.
